title: "Billboard Hot 100"
author: "Gina Cepeda"
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
billboard <- read_csv("data/billboard.csv")
```

```{r}
billboard_long <- billboard |>
  mutate(song = row_number()) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("wk"),
    names_to = "week",
    names_prefix = "wk",
    values_to = "rank"
  ) |>
  mutate(week = as.integer(week))

song_summary <- billboard_long |>
  filter(!is.na(rank)) |>
  group_by(song, artist, track) |>
  summarise(
    first_rank = rank[which.min(week)],
    best_rank = min(rank),
    first_week_at_best_rank = min(week[rank == min(rank)]),
    total_weeks = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  filter(best_rank <= 10)

song_summary |>
  select(artist, track, first_rank, best_rank, first_week_at_best_rank, total_weeks) |>
  knitr::kable(caption = "Summary of songs that reached the top 10")

fastest_to_number_one <- song_summary |>
  filter(best_rank == 1) |>
  arrange(first_week_at_best_rank, artist, track) |>
  slice_head(n = 1) |>
  mutate(notable = "Fastest to number one")

slowest_to_number_one <- song_summary |>
  filter(best_rank == 1) |>
  arrange(desc(first_week_at_best_rank), artist, track) |>
  slice_head(n = 1) |>
  mutate(notable = "Slowest to number one")

longest_top_10_run <- song_summary |>
  arrange(desc(total_weeks), artist, track) |>
  slice_head(n = 1) |>
  mutate(notable = "Longest chart run")

bind_rows(fastest_to_number_one, slowest_to_number_one, longest_top_10_run) |>
  select(notable, artist, track, first_week_at_best_rank, total_weeks) |>
  knitr::kable(caption = "Notable top-10 songs")

notable_songs <- bind_rows(
  fastest_to_number_one,
  slowest_to_number_one,
  longest_top_10_run
) |>
  mutate(notable_song = paste(artist, track, sep = " - ")) |>
  select(song, notable_song)

top10_long <- billboard_long |>
  semi_join(song_summary, by = "song") |>
  left_join(notable_songs, by = "song")

last_week <- billboard_long |>
  filter(!is.na(rank)) |>
  group_by(song) |>
  summarise(last_week = max(week), last_rank = rank[which.max(week)])

last_week |>
  filter(last_week == 20) |>
  summarise(
    songs = n(),
    ranked_below_50 = sum(last_rank > 50)
  ) |>
  knitr::kable()

ggplot(top10_long, aes(x = week, y = rank, group = song)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.25, color = "gray60", na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_line(
    data = filter(top10_long, !is.na(notable_song)),
    aes(color = notable_song),
    linewidth = 0.8,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) +
  scale_y_reverse(limits = c(100, 1), breaks = c(1, 25, 50, 75, 100)) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2", name = "Notable songs") +
  labs(
    title = "Top-10 Songs: Billboard Rankings Over Time",
    x = "Week on chart",
    y = "Billboard rank"
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: Last
weeks <- c("wk1", "wk4", "wk10", "wk20", "wk40", "wk76")

tibble(
  week = weeks,
  present = map_int(weeks, \(week) sum(!is.na(billboard[[week]]))),
  missing = map_int(weeks, \(week) sum(is.na(billboard[[week]])))
) |>
  knitr::kable()
```
